title: The Morning Digest: October 26, 2026
dek: Sunday's reopen traded Brent near $115.7 and WTI near $102.3 in Monday morning reports, about a dollar under Friday's settles of $116.72 and $103.27, after a weekend whose confirmed Saudi events were interceptions and debris against claims on the Rabigh refinery and the East-West Pipeline. The Baltic Exchange Week 43 weekly is published: TD3C at WS 1208.13, TD9 at WS 666 and TD22 at $58.22 million, a second straight sharp dirty correction that has now reached the Caribbean to Gulf leg. The diesel crack printed at $97.49 on the latest validated history, below $100 for a second print after Friday's $97.78 close ended the sustained run that began Aug 17. A calendar correction: the Lake Charles refiner reports Wednesday Oct 28, not Oct 30.
